scope: One concise AQA AS Chemistry 7405 3.3.2.2 cracking-conditions recall card for the confirmed first mock; no duplicate existing core card IDs.

cards.subject: Chemistry
cards.front: Compared with thermal cracking, what pressure does catalytic cracking use?
cards.back: Catalytic: slight pressure; thermal: high pressure.
accept: Catalytic cracking uses slight pressure; thermal cracking uses high pressure.
Thermal cracking requires high pressure but catalytic cracking operates at slight pressure.
Catalytic slight pressure, thermal high pressure.
reject: Catalytic cracking uses high pressure; thermal cracking uses slight pressure.
Both thermal and catalytic cracking require high pressure.
Catalytic cracking occurs at zero pressure while thermal uses high pressure.
